# Ecomshoot
> Precision Commercial Product Photography Studio & Production House
> Official Production Domain: https://www.ecomshoots.in

## Official Studio Identity & Contact Information
- **Brand**: Ecomshoot (Ecomshoot Creative Production Inc.)
- **Website**: https://www.ecomshoots.in
- **Email**: studio@ecomshoots.in
- **Phone**: +91 98765 43210
- **Physical Studio Bay**: Okhla Industrial Area, Phase III, New Delhi, Delhi 110020, India
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM IST | Saturday: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM IST (Intake & Proofing)
- **Primary Business Focus**: Commercial product photography, multi-channel e-commerce catalog production, Amazon/Shopify compliance packshots, lifestyle editorial staging, and high-end digital retouching.

## Commercial Photography Disciplines (HTML & Markdown)
- [Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/product-photography.md)
  High-definition commercial product photography that captures physical textures, authentic color tonality, and structural form.
- [E-Commerce Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/ecommerce-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/ecommerce-product-photography.md)
  Scalable, catalog-ready product photography optimized for Shopify Plus merchants, Amazon FBA sellers, and multi-channel retailers.
- [Lifestyle Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/lifestyle-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/lifestyle-product-photography.md)
  Contextual in-situ product photography with propped interior sets and authentic prop styling that builds deep emotional desire.
- [Fashion & Apparel Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/fashion-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/fashion-product-photography.md)
  Ghost mannequin, editorial flat lay, and on-model apparel photography capturing drape, weave, silhouette, and tactile fabric quality.
- [Creative & Advertising Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/creative-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/creative-product-photography.md)
  Bold, concept-driven hero visuals featuring liquid splashes, kinetic particle levitation, dramatic hard lighting, and custom set designs.
- [Jewellery & Luxury Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/jewellery-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/jewellery-product-photography.md)
  Micro-focus stacked optical captures that eliminate specular glare, rendering diamond fire, gemstone facets, and precious metal luster.
- [Product Photo Editing & Retouching](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/product-photo-editing-retouching) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/product-photo-editing-retouching.md)
  Master digital post-production featuring 100% hand-drawn vector clipping paths, frequency separation skin retouching, and color balancing.
- [White Background Product Photography](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/white-background-product-photography) | [Markdown](https://www.ecomshoots.in/service/white-background-product-photography.md)
  Pure RGB #255,255,255 white background imagery with natural contact drop shadows, engineered for Amazon Main compliance.
